# Role Projects Reference

Complete reference for the `glassfrog projects` and `glassfrog project` commands — the projects a role owns, read either as a role's list or one project by its own id (with full detail).

## Overview

Projects are exposed as **two sibling commands**:

- `glassfrog projects <ROLE_ID>` **lists** the projects a role owns (`GET /roles/{role_id}/projects`). Paginated — walks every page by default. Supports three combinable filters.
- `glassfrog project <PROJ_ID>` **reads one project** by its own id (`GET /projects/{id}`), with full detail. Not paginated.

This is the *role-addressable* project surface — distinct from `glassfrog me projects`, which reads the authenticated practitioner's own projects. The two share the same `Project` model but not a command.

Codebase enrichment skipped — not attempted. This reference is based on the interface contracts and the shipped `--help`.

## `glassfrog projects <ROLE_ID>` — list a role's projects

### Synopsis

```
glassfrog projects <ROLE_ID> [--query TEXT] [--status STATUS] [--tag NAME] [--first-page] [--per-page N] [--base-url URL] [-o FORMAT]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ROLE_ID` | string | required | The role whose projects to list (`role_…`). Exactly one required; zero or more than one is a usage error, no API call. Not validated locally; an unknown/malformed id → `400`/`404`. |

### List flags

The three filters **combine** — each present, non-empty filter is sent as its own query parameter and the API applies them together. With no filter, every project owned by the role is requested.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--query` | `-q` | string | — | Free-text search, sent verbatim as `q`. Sent only when present and non-empty; `--query ""` behaves as no filter. Not validated locally. |
| `--status` | — | string | — | Filter by project status, sent as `status`. **Validated locally** against the set `archived`, `cancelled`, `completed`, `current`, `scheduled`, `someday`, `waiting`; an unsupported value is a usage error naming the value and the set, no API call. Sent only when present and non-empty. |
| `--tag` | — | string | — | Filter by tag name (case-insensitive, matched by the API), sent as `tag`. Free text, passed through; sent only when present and non-empty. |
| `--first-page` | — | bool | false | Fetch only the first page and signal if more exist (see [Completeness signalling](#completeness-signalling)). |
| `--per-page` | — | int | API max | Page size for the walk. The API owns the valid range. |

### List output

Rendered in the resolved format. Format changes rendering, not fetch depth: the list walks to completion in every format (and `--first-page` limits all formats to one page).

**`full`** — one block per project:

```
<proj_…>  [<status>]  <description|—>
  role: <role_…> sub-projects: yes/no actions: yes/no tags: <…>
```

**`compact`** — one line per project:

```
<proj_…>  [<status>]  <description|—>
```

**`json` / `yaml`** — the aggregated `{data:[…]}` document built from each project's raw bytes (per-page `meta` dropped); a valid empty list is `{"data": []}`, never `null`.

**Empty list** (the role owns no projects, or none matched the filters): under `full`/`compact`, stdout is the `projects` template's empty line (`no projects`) and the command exits `0`.

## `glassfrog project <PROJ_ID>` — single read

### Synopsis

```
glassfrog project <PROJ_ID> [--base-url URL] [-o FORMAT]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PROJ_ID` | string | required | The project to read (`proj_…`). Exactly one required. Passed through unvalidated; an unknown id → `404`. |

`project` declares **no list flags** — passing `--query`/`-q`, `--status`, `--tag`, `--first-page`, or `--per-page` is rejected by cobra as an unknown flag (usage error, exit `2`, no request).

### Single-read output

**`full`** — the full single-project detail:

```
<proj_…>  [<status>]
  Description:   <description | —>
  Role:          <role_… | (individual initiative — no role)>
  Parent:        <proj_… | (top-level — no parent)>
  Sub-projects:  yes | no
  Actions:       yes | no
  Tags:          <tag, tag | (none)>
  Created:       <created_at | (unknown)>
  Updated:       <updated_at | (unknown)>
  Link:          <link | (none)>
  Note:          <note | (none)>
```

Each nullable field (`description`, `role_id`, `parent_project_id`, `link`, `note`) renders through an explicit-absence guard rather than a blank; the free-text `note`/`description` are rendered verbatim, never truncated or reflowed.

**`compact`** — one line, detail block omitted:

```
<proj_…>  [<status>]  <description|—>
```

**`json` / `yaml`** — the API's single-project document verbatim.

## Projection fields

### Project (list and single)

| Field | Notes |
|---|---|
| Id | The project id (`proj_…`), always the row lead. |
| Status | The project's status, shown as `[<status>]`. |
| Description | Free text; `—` when absent. |
| Role | The owning role's id; `(individual initiative — no role)` when absent (single read). |
| Parent | The parent project's id (single read); `(top-level — no parent)` when absent. |
| Sub-projects / Actions | Presence flags (`yes`/`no`). |
| Tags | Comma-separated tag names; `(none)` when empty (single read). |
| Created / Updated | Timestamps (single read); `(unknown)` when absent. |
| Link / Note | Free text (single read); `(none)` when absent. |

## Completeness signalling

Applies to `projects` (the list). A partial list is never silently presented as complete — signalled via a note on **stderr**.

| Situation | Behaviour | Exit |
|---|---|---|
| Default (full walk) | Walks every page and renders the complete set. | 0 |
| `--first-page`, more pages exist | Renders the first page; writes to stderr: `note: more projects exist than shown; re-run without --first-page to fetch all` | 0 |
| Mid-walk failure | Renders projects gathered so far; writes to stderr: `note: result is incomplete — <cause>; the projects shown are a partial set` | non-zero |

The single `project` read is unpaginated — no completeness signalling.

## Output formats

Inherited persistent root flags, read by cobra inheritance:

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--base-url URL` | Override the API base URL (top rung of the base-URL precedence chain). |
| `-o`, `--output FORMAT` | `full` (default), `compact`, `json`, or `yaml`. Resolution chain: flag → `GLASSFROG_OUTPUT` → `.glassfrogrc output` → `full`. |

The raw API envelope is never emitted under a human format.

## Failure rendering

Failure rendering is **format-aware** (Output-Aware Failure Rendering): under `json`/`yaml` a failure emits the unified error envelope on **stdout** (so an agent parses success and failure the same way); under `full`/`compact` the diagnostic (cause + next step) goes to **stderr**. The incompleteness notes stay on **stderr** in every format.

## Exit codes and errors

The exit code is the category from the Exit-Code Convention. Every message names the cause and a next step, and never includes the token.

| Condition | Exit | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|
| Projects listed / project read (incl. empty list) | 0 | — (result on stdout; incompleteness note on stderr when applicable) |
| No usable token | 2 | "not authenticated — run `glassfrog auth login` or set GLASSFROG_TOKEN" |
| Unreadable / malformed credential file | 1 | names the credentials file — "fix or re-create it with `glassfrog auth login`" |
| Unknown/forbidden role or project id, or other non-2xx (4xx/5xx) | 3 / 4 / 5 | names the HTTP status + extracted detail; per-class next step |
| Could not reach the wire | 6 | names the transport failure — "check connectivity; the API may be unreachable" |
| 2xx body did not match the expected shape | 3 | "the API response did not match the expected shape — may be an API change; report it" |
| Malformed paging mid-walk (`projects`) | 1 | the walker's text, surfaced inside the incompleteness note |
| Unsupported `--status` value (`projects`) | 2 | "unsupported --status value …" + the supported set; no request sent |
| Base-URL configuration error | 2 | names the malformed base URL + source |
| Invalid `--output` selector | 2 | names the bad format value + the four valid names |
| List-only flag on `project`, or wrong positional count (zero / >1) | 2 | cobra's unknown-flag / arg-count message; no request sent |

Exit codes by category: `0` success, `1` runtime error, `2` usage error, `3` API error, `4` permission error, `5` rate-limited, `6` network unavailable.
